command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "foreach (`$project in @('CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_06','CampusNetwork_07','CampusNetwork_08','CampusNetwork_09','CampusNetwork-for-perf','CampusNetwork-for-perf_02','CampusNetwork-for-perf_04')) { Write-Output ('PROJECT=' + `$project); foreach (`$device in @('PE1','PE2','PE3')) { `$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/' + `$project + '/nodes/' + `$device + '/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'); `$printed=`$false; foreach (`$line in (`$r.output -split '\r?\n')) { if (`$line -match '^static-lsp|^ip route-static 1(50|60)\.0\.0\.1') { if (-not `$printed) { Write-Output ('DEVICE=' + `$device); `$printed=`$true }; Write-Output `$line } } } }"
